# jaff.physics.thermodynamics.eos.config

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Config of the equation of state (`[network.thermodynamics.eos]`).

One model per EOS `type`; `EosConfig` picks the model from `type`
(case-insensitive, `"ideal"` when omitted).

## Classes

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`FermiDegenerateEosConfig`](fermidegenerateeosconfig/index.md) | Non-relativistic degenerate Fermi gas (`type = "fermi_degenerate"`). |
| [`IdealEosConfig`](idealeosconfig/index.md) | Ideal-gas EOS (`type = "ideal"`). |
| [`MultiGammaEosConfig`](multigammaeosconfig/index.md) | Ideal gas with a per-species adiabatic index (`type = "multi_gamma"`). |
| [`RelativisticFermiDegenerateEosConfig`](relativisticfermidegenerateeosconfig/index.md) | Relativistic degenerate Fermi gas (`type = "relativistic_fermi_degenerate"`). |
